posts.title: I Was Sure Nvidia Would Bounce Back. Then I Checked 825 CEO Exits.
posts.description: This morning I wrote that Nvidia would rebound for sure. Then I went through 825 CEO exits. In the 58 that look like this one, most stocks bounced and fewer than half got all the way back.

posts.title: The End-of-Day Reversal After 2019: What a Pre-Registered Test Found
posts.description: A published anomaly, sample ending 2019: intraday losers beat intraday winners in the last half hour. We tested it on 2020–2026 under a pre-registration written before the run, on S&P 500 stocks minus the heavily traded names we had already seen. It is still there. It depends on the window, the end point and the sample, and the paper shows where.

posts.title: Homebuilders Lost 62% While the S&P 500 Hit a Record. That's How 2008 Really Started.
posts.description: On the day the S&P 500 set its 2007 record, the six big homebuilders were already down 62% and $283 billion of short-term funding had vanished. I lined up 38 prices by the date each one peaked. The crash rolled outward from mortgages for 27 months, and the order is measurable.
